anchors.description: Framed wall-mounted whiteboard: 3D straight-line distance between the visible left and right inner edges of the white dry-erase surface, taken horizontally at mid-height of the board.
anchors.visible_evidence: A large white dry-erase board with a thin metal frame is mounted on the beige wall above the desk; its white interior spans roughly x=85..402 px and y=264..545 px, i.e. aspect about 1.17:1 (slightly wider than tall). Two upright whiteboard pens and a small pen/eraser holder sit on the board, consistent with a conventional office whiteboard. Both endpoints of the rendered span lie on the flat white surface just inside the frame.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: No brand, model or size marking is legible, and the board is viewed from a single distance, so the absolute size is not directly encoded. Standard office whiteboards in this appearance class are about 0.9-1.8 m wide; the interval [0.85,1.45] m covers the common 900/1000/1200 mm classes that match the measured ~1.17 aspect.
